problem:
The vector $a$ has magnitude $15$, the vector $b$ has magnitude $2$, the angle between $a$ and $b$ is ${90}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $a\times b.$ Find $a\times b$ in terms of $n.$ 

Type $n$ to represent the vector $n.$  

$a\times b=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}a\times b & =|a|\cdot |b|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =15\cdot 2\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{90}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =30\cdot 1\cdot n \\  & =30n.\end{aligned}
$$
